verse_renderings.text: The most important thing is that you govern yourselves in a way that reflects the true value of the good news of Christ. Then, whether I visit you or only hear about you from far away, I will know that you are standing firm, united in one spirit. I will know that you are competing together as one team to stay faithful to the good news.

Do not let your opponents intimidate you in any way. Your courage will be a clear sign to them that they are headed for destruction, but that you are headed for deliverance—and all of this is from God.
God has graciously given you the privilege not only to trust in Him, but also to suffer for Christ and His cause.
You are facing the same struggle you once saw me face, and that you now hear I am still facing today.
